summary.label: save
summary.name: Save Movie for Later
warnings: attempt 1: Movies are saved to your personal WidgetAI data store (collection 'saved_movies'), not to CineBase's own Watchlist — the site's Watchlist link is not touched.
attempt 1: Movie details (title, year, rating, genres, director, short plot) are read from the page at save time; if the page layout changes, some fields may be empty.

widget.name: Save Movie for Later
widget.description: Adds a Save button to the movie's action toolbar that stores this movie in your personal saved_movies list so you can find it later.
widget.insertionHint: Appended inside the 'Movie actions' toolbar (div.movie-actions[role=toolbar]) next to the Trailer and Share buttons
plan: Wait for the movie detail section and the 'Movie actions' toolbar to appear
Add a 'Save for later' button next to Trailer and Share
Check whether this movie (by its page id, e.g. 'dune') is already in your saved movies and show ★ Saved if so
On click, store the title, year, rating, genres, director, short plot and page link in your 'saved_movies' collection, then confirm it was saved
Click again to remove it from your saved movies

summary.label: list
summary.name: Saved Movies Sidebar
warnings: attempt 1: Saved movie documents may have been written by other widgets, so field names can vary; the widget looks for title/name, year, rating, url, note and savedAt and shows 'Untitled' if no title field exists.
attempt 1: Only links starting with http(s) are made clickable; they open in a new tab.
attempt 1: Shows at most the 200 most recently saved movies.

widget.name: Saved Movies Sidebar
widget.description: Lists the movies saved in your personal saved_movies collection inside the CineBase watchlist sidebar.
widget.insertionHint: Appended to the end of the sidebar <aside id="watchlist-sidebar">; falls back to a fixed bottom-right dock if the sidebar is not found.
plan: Wait for the watchlist sidebar on the page (or fall back to a small floating panel).
Read your saved movies from the shared 'saved_movies' collection in your data store.
List each movie's title, year, rating, saved date and note in a 'Saved movies' card in the sidebar.
Show 'No saved movies yet' if the collection is empty, and offer a Refresh button to reload the list.
